name: Cathy Cleary
title: Senior Psychologist
description: I am a Senior Psychologist providing therapy to adults, couples and seniors at our Malvern Clinic. I provide specialised counselling to survivors of trauma, including First Nations People, Refugees, LGBTQIA+, Veterans and Law Enforcement. I integrate solution-focused therapy, psychoeducation, and evidence-based treatments such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, schema therapy, and strength-based interventions.
specialties: Trauma, PTSD, Complex-PTSD, Gender Transitioning Care, Gender Dysphoria, Gender Identity, LGBTQIA+, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Couples, Veterans
identity: Publicly identifies as: LGBTQIA+, Woman, First Nations, 45+

name: Dr Arthur Sone-Wai Li
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a PhD-qualified clinical psychologist who specialises in chronic pain and mental health management. I use practical methods such as CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Positive Psychotherapy, and biofeedback. I provide counselling in English, Mandarin and Cantonese.
specialties: Childhood Trauma Focused, PTSD, Complex-PTSD, EMDR, Chronic pain, ADHD/Autism assessment, Mandarin, Cantonese

name: Lisa Winther
title: Senior Psychologist
description: I am particularly drawn to therapies that promote an exploration and acceptance of emotions. I work with individuals, couples, and parents facing life transitions, relational difficulties, mood and anxiety issues, chronic pain, and trauma.
specialties: Trauma, PTSD, Complex-PTSD, Intimacy and Relationship Focus, Chronic pain, Fertility, Menopause

name: Sarah Lawry
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: A space where you feel seen, understood and safe to explore your experiences, relationships and the parts of yourself seeking connection. My approach is grounded in trauma informed and attachment-based therapy. Special interests: Complex PTSD, relationship dynamics, family violence, parental alienation.
specialties: Complex PTSD, Childhood Trauma Focused, Dissociative Disorders, Family violence, EMDR, Neurodivergence

name: Tom Rosser
title: Psychologist
description: I have experience working with a range of mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, OCD, self-confidence, PTSD, and more. I have specialised training in trauma treatment using EMDR, and training in Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) for clients with BPD.
specialties: PTSD, Childhood Trauma Focused, EMDR, DBT, Gender Identity, OCD
